messages:
Priya (Design): quick question: for the Dashboard 'Create Route' form should errors be inline immediately or wait until blur/submit? Kofi (Eng): no onChange validation please. onBlur for format checks, submit for cross-field. Ava (PM): product wants fewer false negatives on first try. users get blocked at signup flows. Rhea (Frontend): my pattern: show light validation (icon) while typing, full message onBlur, and top summary on submit that links to fields. less jumpy. Noor (Research): users expect required markers. show '*' and '(optional)'. hiding required confuses some. Priya (Design): propose: '*' visible, '(optional)' label on optional, validate onBlur, show summary on submit with anchors. copy should say how to fix it. a11y-bot: accessibility reminder: set aria-invalid and aria-describedby, role=alert on summary, do not rely on color, ensure contrast. Kofi (Eng): impl note: need unique ids and focus-to-summary helper. I'll add util functions. Rhea (Frontend): code sample: ``
Enter a name (max 64 chars)
``` Priya (Design): destructive actions: typed-confirm for high-risk deletes? seems heavy for everyday items. Noor (Research): participants hate typed-confirm for small deletes. recommend tiered approach: typed-confirm only for irreversible infra actions, modal+undo for normal. Ava (PM): decision: 1) visible '*' + '(optional)' 2) onBlur inline checks, submit summary with anchors 3) aria-invalid/aria-describedby + role=alert 4) tiered destructive confirmations 5) error copy with remediation. Priya (Design): updating mocks and acceptance criteria. tagging @Kofi and @Rhea for estimates. Kofi (Eng): will scope form helpers this sprint. Rhea (Frontend): will implement after helpers. Noor (Research): will run a quick 5-user test next week. Priya (Design): thanks, closing thread unless objections. a11y-bot: checklist posted in #eng-accessibility.
